memory: Michael is a new customer, first-time interaction with the company.Michael is 35 years old, lives in Seattle, works as a freelance graphic designer, and is looking for a high-quality coffee machine that fits his design aesthetic. He is interested in both standard drip coffee makers and espresso machines.Michael is interested in the features of espresso machines, particularly those that can provide a café-like experience at home. He is considering between simpler drip coffee makers and more advanced steam-based espresso systems. He is also looking for a sleek, modern, stainless-steel finish.Michael is interested in pricing and potential discounts for first-time buyers. He saw a 'New Customer Discount' on the homepage but didn't click on it in time. He is also interested in bundle deals and limited-time promotions.Michael is interested in the shipping details, specifically whether the company ships from a local warehouse or out of state. He is also concerned about the shipping time frame, especially since he needs the product before a family gathering later this month.Michael is interested in the customer support experience of your company, which his friend had a positive experience with. He wants to ensure the coffee machine he purchases matches his coffee routine, including brewing frequency, cleaning complexity, and counter space requirements.Michael is concerned about the size of the espresso machine and how it might impact his kitchen setup. He wants to know the dimensions of the machine before making a purchase to plan for any necessary rearrangements.Michael is concerned about the warranty and quality guarantee for the coffee machines. He has had negative experiences with short warranty periods and poor service in the past and is hoping for a more accommodating policy from your company.Michael has had issues with drip coffee makers that don't get hot enough and has to microwave his coffee. He is looking for a machine with adjustable temperature settings or one that produces reliably hot coffee.
